deliveries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a single transparent full-body WALK PASSING animation frame for a 2D fighting game. Input image is the appearance and scale reference: Scraper from Silent Hill: The Arcade (2007), NOT Silent Hill 3. Draw the very same character in ONE distinct passing-step pose, facing screen-right from the same side camera. Preserve the exact cloth veil covering all face and head, dark crown band, muted brown folded tunic and layered hem, striped dark trousers, wrapped forearms, studded wrist cuffs, dark closed shoes and two short steel blades held in the two hands. Change ONLY gait and the small associated arm/body movement. The weight-bearing FAR leg is nearly vertical under the pelvis with its full shoe flat on the ground. The NEAR knee lifts moderately forward to the right, bent about 90 degrees, so that its shoe is visibly raised clear of the ground next to the planted leg's shin; both legs must remain distinct. The pelvis is above the planted foot. Torso still leans a little forward, head and right-facing orientation match the reference. Keep both forearms bent and both hand-held blades readable: leading hand at chest height with blade diagonally upward toward screen-right; rear hand slightly behind the hip on screen-left with its blade diagonally downward and backward. Neither weapon is allowed to become a forearm, change shape or disappear. Same gritty detailed illustrated game art, same wardrobe and proportions, no new wounds, no new props. Whole silhouette and both blade tips must fit inside the CENTRAL 72 percent of the canvas, leaving at least 14 percent genuinely transparent empty margin at each edge; use a generous portrait-shaped canvas near the input native pixel count, not a cropped close-up. One subject and one pose only. True transparent alpha, no floor or shadow, no background, no extra limbs or duplicate, no text, no glow, no colored fringe. This is an authored versus walk pose, no source-accurate timing claim.
deliveries.review: Pose de passage à genou levé. Deux lames, deux mains et deux chaussures entières; costume et voile cohérents. Le genou est haut : cadence de prototype, pas reproduction d'une démarche mesurée. Marges de cadrage minimales 11,21 %, en dessous de la cible 12–15 % mais silhouette intérieure et sans coupe.

deliveries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Editing target: the attached transparent Scraper walk-contact frame. Change ONLY the framing and scale of the existing whole character within the image. Preserve this exact pose, right-facing camera, all anatomy and clothing, head veil, two complete hand-held blades, both fists and shoes, palette, textures and lighting. The character is too close to the right edge. Recompose it substantially SMALLER and centered in a more generous transparent canvas: the COMPLETE silhouette INCLUDING BOTH BLADE TIPS must lie between 18 percent and 82 percent of canvas width, and between 18 percent and 82 percent of canvas height. This means at least 18 percent genuinely transparent empty space above, below, left and right. Do not zoom back into the character, do not crop. Keep a native pixel count similar to the input, do not enlarge image resolution for this edit. Do not add any object, environment, ground, shadow, glow, background color, text or border. Keep actual alpha transparency. One complete Scraper in the same walk-contact pose, only smaller within the generous frame.
deliveries.review: Contact au talon avant et pointe arrière, les deux lames dégagées. Reprise du cadrage uniquement par génération d'image; marges significatives minimales 24,62 %. Le sujet occupe moins de pixels que le premier essai; calibration dédiée nécessaire. Aucune image redimensionnée par script.

deliveries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: ONE transparent full-body defensive GUARD pose for a 2D fighting-game sprite. Use the input as the exact appearance reference for Scraper from Silent Hill: The Arcade (2007). Keep its right-facing side camera, identical body proportions, long dirty ivory cloth veil completely hiding head and face, dark securing head band, brown layered folded short tunic, striped charcoal trousers, brown wrapped forearms, dark studded wrist cuffs and the same worn closed dark shoes. Preserve the TWO separate short broad steel hand-held blades: same lengths, width and rough silver material as the reference, not attached in place of forearms. Change only the posture into a clear held guard: feet set apart in a stable side stance, both knees softly bent, torso slightly drawn back away from the opponent at screen-right. Lift BOTH bent forearms in front of the upper torso and veiled head, with both clenched hands distinctly visible. The near hand is in front of the chest and holds its blade diagonally upward-right. The far hand is higher near the forehead and holds its blade diagonally downward-right, forming a separated protective V with the two complete blades. Maintain clear space between the blade silhouettes and make each blade readable from fist to tip; no fused single weapon, no extra blade. Do not make an attack or a jump. The head, both complete shoes, hands and both blade tips are wholly inside the image. Make the entire character smaller within the canvas than in the reference: center its complete silhouette in the central 70 percent of the canvas, leaving at least 15 percent empty transparent margin on all sides. Portrait canvas near the reference native pixel count, roughly 1217x1293. Same gritty detailed illustrated game material and muted palette, no extra blood or new injuries. One subject, one fixed pose. True transparent alpha, no scenery, no floor, no cast or contact shadow, no halo, no text, no frame, no label, no watermark. This is a new versus guard drawing, not a claim about an original measured Arcade technique.
deliveries.review: Garde tenue, deux avant-bras relevés, deux poings et deux lames visibles en V sans fusion; pieds et tête entiers. Marges minimales 17,32 %. Le geste est une adaptation versus, pas une technique Arcade certifiée.
